endpoints.description: Cross-source research synthesis with key findings, subtopics, knowledge gaps and contradictions
Extract verified facts with type classification, confidence scores, entity recognition and temporal markers
Compare multiple sources for consensus, divergence, unique insights and quality ranking
Score source credibility with bias detection, quality signals, red flags and recommended use
Build chronological timeline from research data with turning points, patterns and future projections
Format citations in APA, MLA, Chicago and Harvard styles with bibliography and in-text examples
Gate research execution with quality threshold checks, blocking flags and chain-to recommendations
ONE-CALL: full research workflow — findings, facts, timeline, contradictions, gaps and synthesized report
